maya (DevEx): heads-up — spotted a recurring onboarding snag in the sample-app where errors from the hosted API are mapped inconsistently across SDKs. repro below.

hamid (SDK): ugh yeah saw that in the Go client. what's the mismatch?

maya (DevEx): root issue: server returns a 401 with body `{"error":"unauthorized", "hint":"token missing scope:inference.write"}` but JS SDK surfaces `UnauthorizedError` with no `retryable` flag; Python surfaces `AuthError` and Go returns plain `http.StatusUnauthorized` wrapped in a generic `APIError`.

luis (sample-app): effects: our quickstart uses a naive refresh-and-retry loop on any 401 which results in an infinite token refresh when the server really means "bad scope" (401 permanent). users hit infinite loops.

kevin (eng): can you paste the snippet? maybe the client should include `error.code` and `metadata.scope` in the typed exception.

maya (DevEx): snippet from log:```json
POST /v1/generate 401
{"error":"unauthorized","hint":"token missing scope:inference.write"}
stack: sample-app#generate -> sdk.request -> sdk.reauth -> sdk.request
```

hamid (SDK): proposed mapping (opinion):
- 400 -> BadRequestError (non-retryable) with `validation` details
- 401 -> AuthError (non-retryable) with `hint` field and `can_retry: false`
- 403 -> PermissionError (non-retryable)
- 429 -> RateLimitError (retryable true, include `retry_after` seconds)
- 5xx -> TransientError (retryable true)
Add `is_retryable` boolean on the typed exception.

kevin (eng): agree on `is_retryable`. additionally we should standardize the exception `code` values so sample apps can switch on them instead of text matching. examples: `ERR_RATE_LIMIT`, `ERR_AUTH`, `ERR_VALIDATION`, `ERR_TRANSIENT`.

sara (PM): +1, also add onboarding copy: "If you see 401 with scope hints, check token scopes; do not auto-refresh indefinitely." That should be in quickstart.

luis (sample-app): action item from my side: patch quickstart to break refresh loop and show a clear dialog: "Token missing scope: inference.write — see docs" instead of retrying. I'll open a PR.

hamid (SDK): impl notes: JS/Python/Go SDKs should return an error shape like: `{
  name: 'AuthError',
  code: 'ERR_AUTH',
  message: 'Unauthorized: token missing scope',
  hint: 'token missing scope:inference.write',
  is_retryable: false
}`

kevin (eng): another nuance: 429 from infra sometimes arrives with a 0 `Retry-After` header. we should prefer `Retry-After` header -> numeric seconds -> fallback to exponential backoff suggested by SDK with jitter. Document this in retry guidance.

ci-bot: build status: sample-app tests failing on `onboarding-refresh-loop` branch — 2 failing tests (retry-loop protection). :exclamation:

maya (DevEx): thanks — can we add a small integration test that simulates 401 with scope-hint and asserts SDK does not attempt unlimited reauth? That will prevent regressions.

hamid (SDK): yeah will add tests for all languages. plan: add typed-exception fixtures + test for `is_retryable` semantics.

kevin (eng): timeline: hamid adds SDK changes + tests this sprint, luis updates quickstart, maya will update docs copy. sara, can you file a short RFC for the standardized error codes?

sara (PM): filing RFC now and linking PRs. will add a migration note for existing clients.

maya (DevEx): thanks team. small UX ask: surface `hint` and `code` on Console error-view so engineers debugging onboarding can see the exact token scope problem.

kevin (eng): will add to Console backlog. low effort.

luis (sample-app): PR opened: #423 — changes quickstart to stop infinite refresh, shows scope hint, adds unit test.

hamid (SDK): PR opened for Node + Python + Go SDKs: #789, includes typed errors + `is_retryable` flag + tests.

maya (DevEx): awesome. follow-ups: update onboarding guide, add integration test, and announce change in `#devex` and `#onboarding` channels. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: migration note: existing consumers will get same numeric HTTP codes, but typed `code` field will be added — fallback to legacy string parsing for one release.

sara (PM): tracked in RFC: https://rwd.internal/rfcs/2026/error-codes-onboard

maya (DevEx): closing loop — thanks all, will monitor support tickets for this next week.
